taxon.wikipedia_summary: Senecio nemorensis is a species of perennial plant from the family Asteraceae that can reach 2 metres (6 ft 7 in) in height. The plant is endemic to Turkey, where it can be found growing at elevation 800–1,800 metres (2,600–5,900 ft).
